verdicts.correction: The documented determination (CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-16) is specifically 'not located -> EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND (GR3b)'. The golden observes only that ON EXCEPTION is taken, but §14.9.4.4 GR3h 1) sends EVERY EC-PROGRAM condition to ON EXCEPTION, and none of the three targets (Cobol.Net.Runtime, System.Runtime, Antlr4.Runtime.Standard) has a callable COBOL entry, so an implementation that DID locate the assembly and attempted a non-COBOL execution (failing with EC-PROGRAM-RESOURCES / ARG-MISMATCH etc.) prints the identical T1..T3=NOT-LOCATED lines; no implementation could print CALLED. T2 (System.Runtime) is not even in the application directory. Fix: move to 2002 (lowest edition with FUNCTION EXCEPTION-STATUS and >>TURN), add '>>TURN EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND CHECKING ON' and in each ON EXCEPTION DISPLAY 'Tn=' FUNCTION EXCEPTION-STATUS, expecting Tn=EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND (probed: T1=EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND at --std 2002). Keep the L1C02F control (SUB / T4=CALLED).

COBOLNET0820 is a SHARED OO structural code (duplicate class, END CLASS/METHOD mismatch, INHERITS cycle), so the .err 'COBOLNET0820' is satisfied by a regression that rejects this group for a different 0820 reason; the .err does not assert this rule's violation. The harness is a case-insensitive substring match and the corpus already uses message-bearing .err files for shared codes (e.g. 'COBOLNET1707: the ACCEPT statement's screen format 3'). Replace the .err with: COBOLNET0820: class 'L1C02H': the INHERITS chain is cyclic   (the emitted text at 2002/2014/2023 is "error COBOLNET0820: class 'L1C02H': the INHERITS chain is cyclic through 'L1C02H' (ISO §11.3.2 ...)"; stop before the §11.3.2 citation, which is the open inherits-cycle-citation finding and will change). Program, reject-at list and citations are otherwise correct (control with J's INHERITS removed compiles clean at 2002).
